children: Indian shares are expected to open little changed on Thursday, as benchmark indexes look to consolidate after a sharp rally driven by sustained foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices and a cooling global AI trade.
GIFT Nifty futures (GIFc1) were at 25,270 as of 8:00 a.m. IST, indicating a muted start for the benchmark Nifty 50
, which ended at a more-than-eight-month closing high of 25,255.05 on Wednesday.

Foreign portfolio investors bought 125.63 billion rupees ($1.34 billion) worth of Indian shares on Wednesday, provisional data showed. They have net bought $6.43 billion of shares in November, already their biggest monthly purchase since September 2024.
The robust inflows have pushed the Nifty 50 and Sensex
indexes up 9.6% and 10%, respectively, so far in November.

The rally marks a reversal for Indian equities, which have lagged their emerging-market peers over the past two years due to elevated oil prices and limited exposure to the global AI-driven market rally.
Brent crude futures
fell more than 1% to $91.8 per barrel on hopes for progress in peace talks over the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine wars.

"Lower crude oil prices continue to provide a supportive backdrop, but the US 10-year Treasury yield hovering near 4.99%, coupled with the market's extended rally, may restrict immediate upside," said Hariselvan Radhakrishnan, founder and CEO of HST Wealth.
MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) dipped 0.1%, weighed down by shares in Hong Kong.
Shares of Adani Green Energy
, Coforge
, Life Insurance Corporation of India
, and Meesho
will be in focus after index provider MSCI added them to MSCI India index. It removed PI Industries
from the index.
STOCKS TO WATCH
** Non-bank lender Bajaj Finance
launches share sale of over $1 billion to institutional investors at a floor price of 992.25 rupees apiece
** Tata Power
names Sanjay Banga as CEO and reported a nearly 49% jump in second-quarter profit on the back of recovering power generation and growth in its renewable energy business
($1 = 93.6900 Indian rupees)
